question: Which bank was set up as an apex body to coordinate the activities of all institutions involved in rural financing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NABARD**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **NABARD** stands for National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development.
 
• It was established on **12 July 1982** by a special act of the Indian Parliament.
 
• NABARD functions as an apex body to provide and regulate credit for the promotion of agriculture, small-scale industries, cottage and village industries, handicrafts, and other rural crafts.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of policies related to rural financing and sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cooperative Banks**

 
 
• These are small-sized units organized in the cooperative sector which operate both in urban and rural areas.
 
• They primarily serve the needs of small and marginal farmers, agricultural laborers, and small entrepreneurs.
 
• Cooperative banks function based on the cooperative principles of mutual help and solidarity.
 
 
 
• **Cooperative Societies**
 
 
• These are voluntary associations of individuals who come together to achieve a common economic objective.
 
• They work on the principle of mutual help and are generally involved in activities like agriculture, credit, production, and distribution.
 
• They aim to provide services to their members rather than to earn profits.
 
 
 
• **The Poor Women Banks**
 
 
• These are specialized financial institutions aimed at providing credit and financial services to poor women, especially in rural areas.
 
• They focus on empowering women through financial inclusion and economic independence.
 
• Examples include self-help groups (SHGs) and microfinance institutions (MFIs) that operate with a similar objective.
 
 

This source code provides a detailed explanation of why NABARD is the correct answer and additional information about the other options, highlighting their roles and functions
